mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_approval_config (asset_type, category, approver_id, approver_name, cc_user_ids, flow_name, description, icon, visibility, settings, sort_order, form_schema, nodes, enabled, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{config.assetType}, #{config.category}, #{config.approverId}, #{config.approverName}, #{config.ccUserIds}, #{config.name}, #{config.description}, #{config.icon}, #{config.visibility}, #{config.settings}, #{config.sortOrder}, #{config.formSchema}, #{config.nodes}, #{config.enabled}, #{config.operatorId}, #{config.operatorId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE approver_id = VALUES(approver_id), approver_name = VALUES(approver_name), cc_user_ids = VALUES(cc_user_ids), flow_name = VALUES(flow_name), form_schema = VALUES(form_schema), nodes = VALUES(nodes), category = VALUES(category), description = VALUES(description), icon = VALUES(icon), visibility = VALUES(visibility), settings = VALUES(settings), sort_order = VALUES(sort_order), enabled = VALUES(enabled), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)

INSERT INTO media_asset_application (application_no, asset_type, title, quantity, reason, status, requester_id, requester_name, department_id, department_name, approver_id, approver_name, form_data, form_schema_snapshot, nodes_snapshot, source_application_id, current_node_index, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{application.applicationNo}, #{application.assetType}, #{application.title}, #{application.quantity}, #{application.reason}, 'PENDING', #{application.requesterId}, #{application.requesterName}, #{application.departmentId}, #{application.departmentName}, #{application.approverId}, #{application.approverName}, #{application.formData}, #{application.formSchema}, #{application.nodes}, #{application.sourceApplicationId}, 0, #{application.operatorId}, #{application.operatorId})

INSERT INTO media_asset_approval_log (application_id, action, actor_id, actor_name, remark, action_data, node_index, node_name) VALUES (#{log.applicationId}, #{log.action}, #{log.actorId}, #{log.actorName}, #{log.remark}, #{log.actionData}, #{log.nodeIndex}, #{log.nodeName})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM media_asset_application WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, asset_type assetType, asset_name assetName, asset_code assetCode, channel_id channelId, channel_name channelName, project_id projectId, project_name projectName, secret_data secretData, status, assignee_id assigneeId FROM media_asset WHERE id IN #{id} AND deleted_at = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE media_asset SET status = 'ASSIGNED', application_id = #{assignment.applicationId}, assignee_id = #{assignment.assigneeId}, assignee_name = #{assignment.assigneeName}, updated_by = #{assignment.operatorId} WHERE id = #{assignment.assetId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' AND deleted_at = 0

UPDATE media_asset SET status = 'ASSIGNED', application_id = #{assignment.applicationId}, project_id = #{assignment.projectId}, project_name = #{assignment.projectName}, assignee_id = NULL, assignee_name = NULL, usage_team = #{assignment.usageTeam}, updated_by = #{assignment.operatorId} WHERE id = #{assignment.assetId} AND asset_type = 'PIXEL' AND status = 'AVAILABLE' AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.asset_type assetType, c.category, c.flow_name name, c.description, c.icon, c.visibility, c.settings, c.sort_order sortOrder, c.form_schema formSchema, c.nodes, c.cc_user_ids ccUserIds, c.enabled, c.updated_at updatedAt, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.id ORDER BY d.sort_order, d.id) FROM media_application_definition d WHERE d.approval_config_id = c.id AND d.deleted_at = 0) applicationDefinitionIds FROM media_approval_config c WHERE c.asset_type = #{assetType} AND c.deleted_at = 0

SELECT id, application_no applicationNo, asset_type assetType, title, quantity, reason, status, requester_id requesterId, requester_name requesterName, department_id departmentId, department_name departmentName, approver_id approverId, approver_name approverName, decision_remark decisionRemark, form_data formData, form_schema_snapshot formSchema, nodes_snapshot nodes, source_application_id sourceApplicationId, current_node_index currentNodeIndex, created_at createdAt, updated_at updatedAt, COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$._requesterDepartmentId')), ''), NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$.departmentId')), ''), ( SELECT CAST(requester.primary_department_id AS CHAR) FROM sys_user requester WHERE requester.id = media_asset_application.requester_id AND requester.deleted_at = 0 ) ) departmentId, COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$._requesterDepartmentName')), ''), NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$.departmentName')), ''), ( SELECT department.dept_name FROM sys_user requester JOIN sys_department department ON department.id = requester.primary_department_id AND department.deleted_at = 0 WHERE requester.id = media_asset_application.requester_id AND requester.deleted_at = 0 ) ) departmentName FROM media_asset_application WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND id = #{id} AND requester_id = #{requesterId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$.applicationCode')) applicationCode, title, status, requester_name requesterName, CAST( COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$.amount')), ''), NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$.rechargeAmount')), '') ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2) ) amount, COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$.amountType')), ''), NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$.currency')), ''), 'USD' ) currency, form_data formData, form_schema_snapshot formSchema, created_at createdAt, decided_at decidedAt FROM media_asset_application WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND ( ( asset_type = 'ACCOUNT_OPERATION' AND ( JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$.accountIds'), JSON_QUOTE(#{accountId})) OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(form_data, '$.accountId')) = #{accountId} ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_asset asset WHERE asset.application_id = media_asset_application.id AND asset.asset_type = 'AD_ACCOUNT' AND REPLACE(asset.asset_code, 'act_', '') = #{accountId} AND asset.deleted_at = 0 ) ) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT log.id, log.application_id applicationId, log.action, log.actor_name actorName, log.node_name nodeName, log.remark, log.created_at createdAt FROM media_asset_approval_log log JOIN media_asset_application application ON application.id = log.application_id AND application.deleted_at = 0 WHERE ( ( application.asset_type = 'ACCOUNT_OPERATION' AND ( JSON_CONTAINS( JSON_EXTRACT(application.form_data, '$.accountIds'), JSON_QUOTE(#{accountId}) ) OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(application.form_data, '$.accountId')) = #{accountId} ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_asset asset WHERE asset.application_id = application.id AND asset.asset_type = 'AD_ACCOUNT' AND REPLACE(asset.asset_code, 'act_', '') = #{accountId} AND asset.deleted_at = 0 ) ) AND log.action IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'COMPLETED', 'TRANSFERRED') ORDER BY log.application_id, log.created_at, log.id

SELECT a.id, a.application_no applicationNo, a.asset_type assetType, a.title, a.quantity, a.reason, a.status, a.requester_id requesterId, a.requester_name requesterName, a.department_id departmentId, a.department_name departmentName, a.approver_id approverId, a.approver_name approverName, a.decision_remark decisionRemark, a.form_data formData, a.form_schema_snapshot formSchema, a.nodes_snapshot nodes, a.source_application_id sourceApplicationId, a.current_node_index currentNodeIndex, a.created_at createdAt, a.updated_at updatedAt FROM media_asset_application a WHERE a.deleted_at = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_asset_approval_log l WHERE l.application_id = a.id AND l.actor_id = #{actorId} AND l.action IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'TRANSFERRED') ) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.id DESC

choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_asset_approval_log processed_log WHERE processed_log.application_id = a.id AND processed_log.actor_id = #{query.userId} AND processed_log.action IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') )
AND FIND_IN_SET( CAST(#{query.userId} AS CHAR), REPLACE( COALESCE( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.form_data, '$._ccUserIds')), '' ), ' ', '' ) ) > 0

if.test: query.queue == 'processed' and query.decisionResult != null and query.decisionResult != ''

mapper.sql: FROM media_asset_application a LEFT JOIN sys_user requester ON requester.id = a.requester_id AND requester.deleted_at = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_department requester_department ON requester_department.id = requester.primary_department_id AND requester_department.deleted_at = 0 LEFT JOIN media_approval_config approval_config ON approval_config.asset_type = a.asset_type AND approval_config.deleted_at = 0 WHERE a.deleted_at = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.application_no applicationNo, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.form_data, '$.applicationDefinitionId')) applicationDefinitionId, a.asset_type assetType, COALESCE( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.form_data, '$.configCategory')), approval_config.category ) configCategory, a.title, a.quantity, a.reason, a.status, a.requester_id requesterId, a.requester_name requesterName, a.approver_id approverId, a.approver_name approverName, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.form_data, '$._ccUserIds')) ccUserIds, a.created_at createdAt, a.updated_at updatedAt, departmentId, departmentName, COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.form_data, '$.projectName')), ''), NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.form_data, '$.channelName')), ''), NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.form_data, '$.project')), '') ) projectName
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT DISTINCT value, label
AND IS NOT NULL AND IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label, value

SELECT DISTINCT CAST(a.requester_id AS CHAR) value, a.requester_name label
ORDER BY label, value

SELECT c.id, c.asset_type assetType, c.category, c.flow_name name, c.description, c.icon, c.visibility, c.settings, c.sort_order sortOrder, c.form_schema formSchema, c.nodes, c.cc_user_ids ccUserIds, c.enabled, c.updated_at updatedAt, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.id ORDER BY d.sort_order, d.id) FROM media_application_definition d WHERE d.approval_config_id = c.id AND d.deleted_at = 0) applicationDefinitionIds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_asset_application a WHERE a.asset_type = c.asset_type AND a.requester_id = #{userId} AND a.deleted_at = 0) usageCount FROM media_approval_config c WHERE c.deleted_at = 0
AND c.enabled = 1 AND (c.visibility = 'all' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted_at = 0 AND UPPER(r.role_code) IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') ))
ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id

SELECT f.id, f.original_name originalName, o.file_size fileSize, o.mime_type mimeType, o.bucket_name bucketName, o.object_key objectKey FROM sys_file f JOIN sys_file_object o ON o.id = f.file_object_id AND o.deleted_at = 0 AND o.storage_status = 'AVAILABLE' WHERE f.deleted_at = 0 AND o.mime_type LIKE 'image/%' AND f.id IN
#{fileId}

SELECT d.id departmentId, d.dept_name departmentName FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.primary_department_id AND d.status = 1 AND d.deleted_at = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0

SELECT u.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), u.username) name, d.id departmentId, d.dept_name departmentName FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.primary_department_id AND d.status = 1 AND d.deleted_at = 0 WHERE u.primary_department_id = #{departmentId} AND u.id != #{excludedUserId} AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY u.id
SELECT payment_address paymentAddress FROM media_channel WHERE id = #{channelId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.spend_amount), 0) FROM media_channel_campaign_spend s JOIN media_channel_account a ON a.account_id = s.account_id AND a.deleted_at = 0 WHERE a.channel_id = #{channelId} AND s.spend_date = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND s.deleted_at = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) fileCount, COALESCE(MAX(o.file_size), 0) maxFileSize FROM sys_file f JOIN sys_file_object o ON o.id = f.file_object_id AND o.deleted_at = 0 WHERE f.id IN #{id} AND f.uploader_id = #{userId} AND f.deleted_at = 0 AND o.storage_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND o.mime_type LIKE 'image/%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT id, display_name displayName FROM sys_user WHERE id IN #{id} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT id, role_name roleName FROM sys_role WHERE id IN #{id} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted_at = 0 JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at = 0 WHERE ur.role_id IN #{id} AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY u.id
SELECT id, dept_name departmentName FROM sys_department WHERE id IN #{id} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY id

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.primary_department_id AND d.status = 1 AND d.deleted_at = 0 WHERE u.primary_department_id IN #{id} AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY u.id
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(account_name, ''), account_id) FROM ad_account_asset WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted_at = 0

SELECT account_id AS accountId, COALESCE(channel_name, '') AS channelName FROM ad_account_asset WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND id = ( SELECT MAX(candidate.id) FROM ad_account_asset candidate WHERE candidate.account_id = ad_account_asset.account_id AND candidate.deleted_at = 0 ) AND account_id IN #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_account_asset asset JOIN ( SELECT account_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM ad_account_asset WHERE deleted_at = 0 GROUP BY account_id ) latest ON latest.id = asset.id SET asset.inventory_status = 'ASSIGNED', asset.updated_by = #{operatorId}, asset.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE asset.account_id IN #{id}
